questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Experiencing new cultures and academic challenges, as well as living in a safe and beautiful city.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The lectures at Charles University wasn't academically challenging, as studying at Københavns Universitet is. Some teachers weren't even good at English and seemed insecure while teaching.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was quite easy

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: There was a mobility coordinator, we could contact if we had any questions.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was quite easy for us, even though we were out a bit too late. I can't recommend the place.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It is more expensive, but it can be more central and with better living conditions

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I didn't choose the housing through the University as it had bad reviews and a 45 minute commute from the campus

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I can't remember it.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: There was a mobility coordinator, we could contact if we had any questions.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes I wanted, but that wasn't the case for every student

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I would only advice students to choose Charles University if they really want to go to Prague or want an academic break, but I won't advice them to do it if they need to be challenged.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The levels where pretty low, but my ects points each course were 3, 5 and 6, which made it easier to study the different courses.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was bad. One of the teachers only showed us youtube videos when teaching us - and we only had to do this course every other week for 1,5 hour. So it was pretty unprofessional that he couldn't teach us for that small amount of time.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer:
OEBQZ170 37 Equity in Education

OEBCC210 Psycholinguistics

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
OEBLL211 6Z Literar(II)y Czech. A Selection from Personalities of Czech Literature
OEBXO2106Z Educators, Language, Culture, and Society: Linguistic Anthropology, even though the teacher was a bit weird. But exciting materials we had to read and discuss.

questions.answer: My roommates were bad at cleaning the kitchen, so I didn't want to cook as much at home because it was disgusting, so I ate out a lot.

questions.answer: Rent is really expensive in Prague - our seems cheap but we were two people in one room. Food and drinks were cheap!

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I would really recommend future students to visit cities around Prague, and choose to travel green as it is a beautiful country.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: I think it was quite easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The language and the degree of friendliness.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The beautiful city, the architecture.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- choose a room for yourself unless you're really close with your roommate
- choose Prague if you want to live in a beautiful and safe city, but don't care about how challenging your studies should be (because it is too easy)
- if its possible, try to connect with other UCPH students before leaving

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: No

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Living in another country, and surviving even though it is tough

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Living in an apartment with other people who doesn't clean.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
